=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:159; 777-834; 1021-1052 (template twin .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py is the same blob) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_UNITTEST_RE` captures only the unittest method name and drops the class, so `FAIL: test_same (mod.ClassA)` on the merge-base and `FAIL: test_same (mod.ClassB)` on the changed tree both become `["test_same"]`; `new_names` is empty and classify_baseline() marks the new failure as inherited.
  WHY: The gate reports pass for a regression the change caused, which reopens the hole issue #10249 is meant to close for unittest files that reuse a method name across classes. Severity disagreement: four reviewers rated it MAJOR (high) and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT; the highest rating is used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:628-631; 455-468; 233-246 (and the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_is_indirect_entry()` accepts only reasons that start with `helper:test_`, but `select_tests()` emits `helper:{hp.stem}` for any test module `is_test_file()` recognises, including `*_test.py` files and files under `__tests__/`, so importers of those modules (for example `helper:foo_test`) are not classified as indirect.
  WHY: In consumer repos that use `*_test.py` or `__tests__/`, importer units are planned with the direct units, before the registry and static checks, so a spent 15-minute budget leaves the direct tests and registry checks unverified, the opposite of issue change 4. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:77; 756-759; 1039-1044 (the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py is the same blob) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Failing names are parsed from the 4 KB tail (`output[-TAIL_BYTES:]`), so when a run prints more than 4096 bytes the headers of earlier failures are cut off, `len(names)` falls below the failures+errors count, and the unit becomes `names_unreadable` (unverified, reason baseline_names_unreadable) with no repair turn.
  WHY: The real file tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_orchestrate_child_count.py from PR #10228 prints unittest tracebacks with full assertIn reprs that go past 4096 bytes, so the real replay gives Status: unverified instead of the "Status: fail" the issue's acceptance requires. Rated MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "For every inherited unit, keep the first failing assertion or error line of the baseline run in the gate log under one stable prefix." (also phrased as "A gate log shows, for each inherited file, the first failure line of the baseline run.")
  expected_change_site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh baseline diagnostic python3 -I -c block (`for outcome, entry in rows[:50]`, line 488), plus the result["inherited"] building path in .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py around line 1325
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The wrapper prints only rows[:50] (lines 485-488), but nothing in classify_baseline(), select_tests() (lines 519-529) or run_gate() caps inherited units at 50, so units past the 50th get no PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=baseline line. baseline_names_unreadable rows in result["unverified"] are clipped too, and no line or counter reports the drop. Recent PRs had 33-43 inherited files and this PR has 49, so passing 50 is plausible. The "at most 50" in the README and agents.d fragment documents the truncation rather than fixing it.
- requirement: (acceptance) "Replaying #10228's case in a test ... gives Status: fail before the repair turn and lists the six new test names as caused by the change."
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, the source of the names used by _unit_failing_set() and _failing_names_readable()
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: test_replay_10228_reports_six_new_names_as_caused uses stub files that print one short "FAIL: name (mod.Case)" line per test and never reach TAIL_BYTES. The real tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_orchestrate_child_count.py output goes past 4096 bytes and hits the truncated-tail baseline_names_unreadable path. No hunk parses names from the full output.
- requirement: "Run the units that match by name or by direct reference first, so the units added by change 3 are the ones that go unverified if the budget runs out."
  expected_change_site: plan_units() and run_units() in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: plan_units() places indirect units last, but run_units() submits every unit to a ThreadPoolExecutor immediately (lines 762-768). With the default four workers, indirect units can start at the same time as direct ones and share the same deadline, so list order does not guarantee that only indirect units go unverified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (the live copy .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py is the same blob in the diff):TAIL_BYTES = 4096 (line 77); _run_one() lines 756-759; classify_baseline() lines 1039-1044 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Failing names are parsed from the 4 KB tail, so in runs longer than 4096 bytes the headers of earlier failures are cut off, len(names) is smaller than the totals count, and the unit becomes baseline_names_unreadable (unverified, no repair turn).
  WHY: The real PR #10228 file tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_orchestrate_child_count.py (unittest.main() at line 188, 27 assertIn/assertEqual calls with full reprs) goes past 4096 bytes, so the replay gives Status: unverified instead of fail. Suggested fix: compute the names on the full decoded output in _run_one and have _unit_failing_set prefer that list.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (and the live copy):_UNITTEST_RE line 159; failing_names() lines 793-803; classify_baseline() line 1045 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unittest name comparison drops the TestCase class and module, so ClassA.test_same and ClassB.test_same both reduce to ["test_same"], and failing_names() dedupes them.
  WHY: new_names is empty, so the unit stays inherited and the gate passes a failure the change caused. pytest node IDs are not affected. Suggested fix: capture the parenthesised qualifier for comparison only.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (and the live copy):_is_indirect_entry() lines 628-631; select_tests() lines 455-468; is_test_file() lines 238-243 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reason "helper:foo_test" (from a *_test.py helper) is not recognised as indirect, so plan_units() plans the importer with the direct units.
  WHY: In consumer repos that use *_test.py, importers run first and the direct tests and registry checks go timeout/unverified, the opposite of issue change 4. No test covers this. Suggested fix: startswith("helper:") and is_test_file(reason[7:] + ".py").
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "For every inherited unit, keep the first failing assertion or error line of the baseline run in the gate log under one stable prefix."
  Expected change site: the baseline diagnostic block in scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh (the new python3 -I -c block after the status check)
  Evidence of absence: The block iterates over rows[:50], and no inherited cap exists in classify_baseline() or select_tests(). This PR reports 49 inherited files and the issue cites 33 to 43. Extra units get no PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=baseline line, and nothing reports the drop. Fix: raise the cap or print "phase=baseline outcome=truncated omitted=N".
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement (acceptance): "Replaying #10228's case in a test ... gives Status: fail before the repair turn and lists the six new test names as caused by the change."
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, the source of the names used by _unit_failing_set() and _failing_names_readable()
  Evidence of absence: test_replay_10228_reports_six_new_names_as_caused uses single-line stubs that never reach TAIL_BYTES. The real file's output goes past 4096 bytes and becomes baseline_names_unreadable. No hunk parses names from the full output.
- HARDENING: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh, clean() in the new python3 -I -c baseline block: only \x00-\x1f and \x7f are stripped, so C1 controls such as \x9b reach the runner log. Fix: r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f-\x9f]" (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
